phase_name: Acceptance verification against a pre-existing settings file

objectives.description: Create and pre-seed scratchpad fixture with pre-existing settings.json and settings.local.json
Run merge_settings headlessly twice against the fixture, confirm additive/idempotent/non-overwriting behavior
Optional end-to-end tier: manager.load('core') then manager.load('web') against fixture project_dir
objectives.note: Required correcting invocation to require(...).create(config):load(...) rather than a bare .manager table; both loads succeeded (ok2=true).

approaches_tried.reason: init.lua exposes M.create(config) returning a manager instance; there is no module-level M.manager table.
